clue.text: Man, for example, in attempt to take in exercise

indicators.note: to take in means the first word swallows the second, holding it within itself

parts.note: a bid is an attempt
PE is physical education, i.e. exercise

explanation.surface: Someone tries to fit some exercise into their day.
explanation.definitionFit: A human walks on two legs, so is one example of a two-footed creature.

clue.text: A follower loudly deluded upset and terribly confused

parts.note: B follows A in the alphabet

indicators.note: upset means the letters are knocked out of their order

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical direction for loudly

explanation.surface: A deluded disciple becomes upset and badly muddled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A follower' is B because B comes after A in the alphabet; 'upset' mixes F in with the letters of the deluded word.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone utterly bewildered or fuddled, perhaps by drink, is in a muddled state.

clue.text: Saw wanderer in lead

indicators.note: in places the wanderer inside the symbol for lead

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
a rover is a wanderer

explanation.surface: A traveller is seen in the lead position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' is not the past of see: it is a noun meaning an old saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or maxim, the same as an adage.

clue.text: Study-time can be a little hollow

parts.note: a den is a private study

explanation.surface: A short spell in the study can feel empty.
explanation.definitionFit: A dent is a small depression in a surface.

clue.text: Riverside plant?

parts.note: reads as a flower by a stream, but the plant is a factory, a mill driven by the flowing river

explanation.definitionFit: A mill powered by a wheel turned by a river stands on its bank as industrial works.

clue.text: To attain penal reform, its output is in bags

indicators.note: reform means the letters are reshaped into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Penal reform is the aim, and the product comes packaged.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate growing leaves for brewing ships its crop, which ends up in teabags.

clue.text: Girl has rugby article cut short

parts.note: RU is Rugby Union

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter of the article is dropped

parts.note: 'the' is the definite article

explanation.surface: A girl has her rugby report trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is a girl's name, as in the Old Testament book.

clue.text: Exclusive society pouring all over the place

indicators.note: all over the place means the letters are scattered in a new order

explanation.surface: An elite club sees drink spilt everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A clique is a closed circle that excludes outsiders.

clue.text: Les takes in naughty schoolboy's written work

indicators.note: takes means the name Les holds the next word within it

explanation.surface: Les takes in a badly behaved pupil's homework.
explanation.definitionFit: A punishment at school was writing out a sentence many times over as an imposition.

clue.text: Father-confessor is one who makes headlines

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest
one who owns up confesses, so a confessor is an owner-up

explanation.surface: A priest hearing confessions turns out to be a newspaper sensation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'headlines' are lines on the forehead, not newspaper banners.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone scowling creases their brow, putting lines on their head.

clue.text: Seamstress's method of controlling pain in the side?

parts.note: running a business means controlling it
a stitch is a sharp pain in the side

explanation.surface: A seamstress has a way to manage a side ache.
explanation.definitionFit: A simple sewing technique of in-and-out stitches used for seams and gathering.

clue.text: Get body substance from eating out before noon

indicators.note: before places the anagram ahead of the next letter
out signals that the letters of eating are put out of order

explanation.surface: Something gets into the body from a late-morning meal out.
explanation.definitionFit: A molecule that prompts the immune system to make antibodies is found in or enters the body.

clue.text: Animal in long grass on its back

indicators.note: on its back means the down word is read upwards, back to front

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass

explanation.surface: An animal lies on its back in tall grass.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag or doe is a wild ruminant animal.

clue.text: It sounds the end of king and his mistress!

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
Nell Gwyn was the mistress of King Charles II

explanation.surface: A king's affair with his mistress spells his downfall.
explanation.walkthrough: Nell Gwyn was an actress and the famous mistress of King Charles II of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell tolled for a death or funeral announces an ending.

clue.text: Domesticated animals with firm quarters

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm
W and S, west and south, are two quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: Farm animals housed in a company's living quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: Dairy cattle are the classic tame farm beasts.

clue.text: In slip of memory, left peas cooking

indicators.note: cooking means the letters are stirred into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone forgets and leaves the peas on the stove.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief failure, as in a lapse of concentration, is a small mental slip.

clue.text: Call for a round of drinks

definitions.meaning: informal for one's turn to buy drinks, as in 'my treat'

explanation.definitionFit: A loud cry; also, in British and Australian slang, a turn to buy everyone a drink.

clue.text: In this office, one may turn up the volume

definitions.text: In this office, one may turn up the volume

parts.words: In this office, one may turn up the volume
parts.note: suggests boosting the sound, but here the volume is a book being found, and the office is a post or job

explanation.definitionFit: The post of a person managing a collection of books, who will locate any tome asked for.

clue.text: Supporters needed for record piles knocked over

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record

indicators.note: knocked over means the pile's letters tumble into a new order

explanation.surface: Fans are needed because a stack of records was toppled.
explanation.definitionFit: Followers of a teacher or leader are devoted adherents.

clue.text: Aged tutor pass out such people, for more advanced work?

definitions.text: such people, for more advanced work

indicators.note: out means the letters are put out of their order

explanation.surface: An elderly tutor sees students through to higher study.
explanation.definitionFit: Graduates continuing to higher degrees do research beyond a first degree.

clue.text: Colour of FBI agents in depression?

indicators.note: in places the agents inside the hollow

parts.note: a pit is a hollow or depression
G-men are FBI agents

explanation.surface: FBI agents are feeling blue.
explanation.walkthrough: G-men, 'government men', is American slang for FBI agents.
explanation.definitionFit: A substance that gives paint or skin its tint is a colouring matter.

clue.text: Could be near the capital

indicators.note: could be means the letters may be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: It might be close to the capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Tehran is the chief city and seat of government of Iran.

clue.text: Silver-lined vessel sinks

indicators.note: lined means the vessel has a lining of the silver within it

parts.note: SS is a steamship, a vessel
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A silver-lined boat goes down.
explanation.definitionFit: Droops, sinking lower under weight, as a sagging mattress does.

clue.text: Sheer energy in pace

indicators.note: in puts the energy inside the pace

parts.note: a step is a pace
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Pure energy goes into the stride.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheer cliff is precipitous, rising almost vertically.

clue.text: Way to tear narrow band of material

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
to rip is to tear

explanation.surface: The way to tear a thin band of fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: A long thin piece of cloth or other stuff.

clue.text: He makes a hit in Bangkok

indicators.note: makes means the letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A man scores a success in Bangkok.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in Bangkok' completes the definition: a man found there is a native of Thailand.
explanation.definitionFit: A man from Thailand, whose capital is Bangkok.

clue.text: Show locks

definitions.meaning: a stage musical of 1967 about hippies

explanation.definitionFit: A famous rock musical shares its name with the growth on one's scalp.

clue.text: Fair, simply

explanation.definitionFit: One word means equitable and also means merely or only.

clue.text: Stylish cricket-side in a net, possibly

indicators.note: in puts the side inside the scrambled net
possibly means the letters might be arranged another way

parts.note: leg is the on side of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A smart cricket team practises in the nets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns A NET into EANT; LEG goes in after the E.
explanation.definitionFit: Graceful and refined in appearance, as a chic outfit is.

clue.text: Ne plus ultra members oddly unaligned

indicators.note: oddly means the letters are put in an odd new arrangement

explanation.surface: The ultimate in members acting strangely is staying non-aligned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' shuffles NE and ULTRA together; 'plus' joins them and 'members' is padding for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A country taking no side in a conflict is non-aligned.

clue.text: Man put on an overcoat?

parts.note: Peter is a man's name
a sham is a put-on, a pretence

explanation.surface: A man pulls on a coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy woollen greatcoat named after Viscount Petersham.

clue.text: Fashions not right for nurses?

indicators.note: not means the right is left out of the fashions

parts.note: trends are fashions

explanation.surface: Wrong fashions for nurses' uniforms?
explanation.definitionFit: To nurse the sick is to look after or care for them.
